detail.name: John RPG
detail.description: Unknown hero who forgot his past for whatever reason.

detail.name: Lily
detail.description: Daughter of the strongest mage in the world, she learned everything from her mother.

detail.name: Mary
detail.description: An orphan who grew up in a church. She developed an understanding of the world and religion there.

detail.name: Luke
detail.description: A young man from a small village who wants to be a soldier one day.

detail.name: Adira
detail.description: She is a commander of Templar and known as the strongest woman in the world.

detail.name: Kiara
detail.description: Adira's sister and biggest fan. She admires her strength, hoping that one day she will be like her.

detail.name: Land
detail.description: He became a lancer because he thinks riding a horse is cool and wants to name himself 'Land the Lancer'.

detail.name: Timmie
detail.description: Grew up in a forest with hunters; he has strong survival and stealth skills.

detail.name: Cole
detail.description: He's scared of getting hit, so he stacks the strongest armor possible and only uses an axe because of the weight.
